en.hubeali: Ibn Mahboub, from Hisham Bin Salim who said,
‘I heard Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> saying: ‘The small persistent deed upon the conviction is superior in the Presence of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> than the big deed performed without conviction’.
en.sarwar: 3. Ibn Mahbub has narrated from Hisham ibn Salim who has said the following: “
I heard abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) saying, ‘The little but continuous deed with certainty is far better in the sight of Allah than a great deal of deeds without certainty.’”
